statement.excerpt: The jokes were bad, the voice was soulless and inaccurate, the pace was languid, and the world will have forgotten about it in two weeks unless Carlin’s estate sues (and I desperately hope they do so).

from_speaker: the world will have forgotten about it
our_interpretation: Two weeks from the January 16, 2024 post ends on January 30, 2024.
The forecast applies only if Carlin's estate does not sue over the special within that window.
Forgotten means that broad public and media attention has largely faded, rather than that every person literally forgets the special.
The comments about joke quality, voice quality, and pacing are subjective and are not scored.
criteria.support_condition: If the estate does not sue by January 30, contemporaneous coverage and audience activity show that broad attention has largely faded by that date.
criteria.contradiction_condition: If the estate does not sue by January 30, substantial continuing public attention at the deadline contradicts the forecast. Attention following a qualifying lawsuit cannot contradict this conditional prediction.
